C0592.title: Guangdong Shantou Hotel Investigated for Listing Prices Far Above Actual Transaction Prices
C0592.summary: In February 2026, the Market Supervision Administration of Shantou, Guangdong Province, initiated an investigation into a hotel. Preliminary findings revealed that none of the hotel's room listings had ever been sold at the displayed 'strikethrough price,' and all actual transaction prices were significantly lower than those reference prices.
